```json
             {"metric": "rout", "op": ">=", "value": 26e6},
             {"metric": "v_compliance", "op": "<=", "value": 0.22}],
 "topology": "self-biased wide-swing NMOS cascode mirror (sink), ratio by m=4",
 "rationale": "A simple mirror would need an Early voltage near 2 kV to reach 26 MΩ, so a cascode is required. A series resistor in the input branch biases the cascode and holds the bottom devices at Vds≈0.13 V. Both bottom devices see the same Vds, which gives accurate 1:4 matching using m=4 unit copies. Running near weak inversion (gm/Id≈18-20) keeps compliance ≈Vds1+Vdsat≈0.2 V. Long L gives Rout≈gm4·ro4·ro2 >30 MΩ. Supply current is 100 µA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),    # bottom mirror devices gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),       # bottom mirror L (matching + ro)
    "gmid3": (20.0, 12.0, 26.0),    # cascode devices gm/Id (low Vdsat)
    "L3":    (1.5, 0.3, 3.0),       # cascode L (intrinsic gain)
    "vds1":  (0.13, 0.08, 0.20),    # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 80e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    ratio = max(1, int(round(iout / iin)))
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # bottom mirror pair (unit device = M1, output = ratio copies)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iin, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iin * ratio, vds=vds1)
    vgs1 = m1.vgs

    # cascode devices: source at vds1 (body effect), input cascode drain at node b = vgs1
    vds3 = max(vgs1 - vds1, 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], iin, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], iin * ratio, vds=max(vout - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)

    # resistor: Va = Vgs1 + I*R ; Vds1 = Va - Vgs3  ->  R = (vds1 + vgs3 - vgs1)/Iin
    R = (vds1 + m3.vgs - vgs1) / iin
    R = min(max(R, 100.0), 1e6)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -> R -> b ; cascode gate at iin (top of R), mirror gate at b
    n.R("R1", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("M3", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4, m=ratio)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m2, m=ratio)

    # predictions
    ro2 = 1.0 / max(m2.gds, 1e-15)
    ro4 = 1.0 / max(m4.gds, 1e-15)
    rout = ro2 + ro4 + (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) * ro4 * ro2
    v_comp = vds1 + 0.7 * m4.vdsat           # 95% criterion allows slight triode entry
    # error: residual from cascode Vds difference between branches (tiny) + finite rout
    dvd = abs((vout - vds1) - vds3)
    err = 100.0 * dvd / (rout * iout) + 0.2
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "power": 1.8 * (iin + iout)}
```
